member.name: T:WebBanHang.Api.Data.ImageSync
member.summary:
dotnet run -- sync-images [--apply] [--download]
The SQL backup is older than the live site: images were re-uploaded there with a new random suffix ("may-giat-labowash-rf6088w_0c5.jpg" in the DB, "…_cb9.jpg" online), so the stored names 404. For every product/category whose image is missing this finds the current file name on the old site: the product page's og:image first, then the category listings (same name without the "_xxx" suffix, or the only image whose name contains the product code).
Without --apply it only prints what would change; with it the old values are saved to a CSV first. --download also copies the images into wwwroot/Photos so the storefront no longer depends on the old site (MediaService serves local copies first).
